messages:
ajay: Heads-up — EU GPU pool bootstrap failing after yesterday's KMS policy change. New nodes can't decrypt model blobs; provisioning stuck ~20m. Logs show kms:DecryptDenied for the node role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/gpu-node-role.
noah: seeing same in eu-west-1, also noticed audit-collector endpoint returning 403 from nodes (egress to logging proxy blocked?).
sre-bot: alert: node-provision-failure (eu-west-1) 3130002430 — 12 failures in last 10m.
maria: firewall team rolled a tightened egress rule to block external collectors earlier today. Could be related.
jun: quick check — the KMS key policy change included a condition on EncryptionContext/env. Our bootstrap agent doesn't set that context. Which PR changed the policy?
ajay: PR 7892 by security team. Condition added to require encryption context "env=prod" for Decrypt.
securitybot: policy-change: PR#7892 applied 2026-03-20T22:14Z by @lisa. Deployed to all regions.
noah: workaround idea: add a temporary allow for the node role to call Decrypt (eu-west-1 only) until bootstrap agent is patched. Security tradeoff — opens a narrow window. Thoughts? :warning:
maria: agree temporary allow for node-role in eu-west-1 only, add audit annotations and 2-hour TTL on the statement. Also, if we re-route logs to longer retention, S3 cost increases — rough estimate +$120/day if we keep full verbose audit for 30d.
jun: patch to the bootstrap agent to include encryption-context is small. I can prepare a canary in staging now, but rolling to the eu warm pool will be ~40m.
ops-oncall: can we fallback to US pools instead while this is fixed? Cross-region failover will increase egress NAT costs and latency — rough calc +$0.12/req and added latency ~120ms median. Customer SLO hit risk.
ajay: decision: temporary allowlist for gpu-node-role in eu-west-1 + ops patch the bootstrap agent to send encryption-context; deploy warm-pool patch overnight. Maria coordinate the ACL change and tagging, Jun prepare canary.
noah: added an ops runbook snippet to the incident page: to test decrypt locally run:
```bash
aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://model.blob --encryption-context '{"env":"prod"}' --key-id alias/model-key
```
maria: opened emergency change CHG-5521 and routed for expedited approval. Tagging @lisa for signoff.
securitybot: note: granting temporary decrypt will generate audit entries with principal and sourceIp — retention alert threshold still set to 30d.
ops-oncall: applying allowlist now to eu-west-1 role (statement TTL=2h). Will monitor auth logs for any anomalies and rollback if suspicious.
jun: canary pushed to staging; if green, I'll roll to warm pool in 40m and trigger warmup.
ajay: thanks all. If anything goes sideways, flip routing to region-fallback=on to send new requests to us-east-1. Keep updates here.
ops-oncall: allowlist applied, seeing successful Decrypts on 6 new nodes, provisioning progressing. Monitoring CPU, KMS audit logs, and firewall hits. Will post final status in 30m.
notes: thread about KMS policy change, firewall egress, temporary allowlist, bootstrap agent patch, canary, cost/latency tradeoffs
